payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for evaluating models in the human-machine communication game, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and interpretability.

claims.text: Models are evaluated based on the retention rate of tokens, which measures the fraction of tokens kept in the keywords.
The accuracy of a communication scheme is measured by the fraction of sentences generated that exactly match the target sentence.
Multi-objective optimization is used to achieve desirable tradeoffs between efficiency and accuracy in the communication schemes.
The communication schemes are designed to be interpretable by restricting keywords to subsequences of the source sentences.
